_what_this_is: A sample of the publisher's settings file, for the container. Copy it beside compose-fragment.yml as settings.json and fill in the four paths and the project routes. Every value is a path, an address or a name; the credential itself is NEVER in this file: only the path of the file that holds it, which is mounted read-only into the container and read once at start.
_host: 0.0.0.0 on purpose. Inside its own container, on a network shared only with the coordinator and with NO port published to the host, the publisher must listen on every address of the container or the coordinator cannot reach it. The default in code is 127.0.0.1, which is right for a test and wrong for the container: a publisher left on 127.0.0.1 inside a container answers nobody, and fails SILENTLY. The boot line of the coordinator and the publisher's own start line both say where it was told to listen, so this is caught on the day.
_known_hosts_file: Needed only when a remote is an SSH address (git@host:owner/repo.git): the pinned host keys, mounted read-only from FORGE_PUBLISHER_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE. The credential file is then the deploy key itself.
_private_path_prefixes: Required. The folders that exist only on the factory's own machines: each factory machine's owner home folder, the host receipts folder and the sandbox storage folder, as absolute paths. Before every send the publisher refuses a commit that would publish a file naming one. A shared folder such as /home/ or /var/ is refused, because it would match ordinary product files. The values below are placeholders.

the-project-name-as-registered.source: the read-only git address the joined commit is brought out of (the sandbox's git daemon, or the project's copy)
the-project-name-as-registered.remote: the address of the remote named origin, WITHOUT any credential in it: an SSH address (git@host:owner/repo.git) to push with a deploy key, or an https address to push with a token
the-project-name-as-registered._credential_name: Optional, and only for a project that needs a key of its own (a deploy key is accepted by one repository only). The bare NAME of its key file, never a path: the file is /etc/forge-publisher/route-keys/<name>, mounted read-only from FORGE_PUBLISHER_ROUTE_KEYS_DIR. Delete the line below to use credential_file for this project; a name that is not there stops the publisher at start, it never falls back.
